rationale: The request expresses one collective sightseeing interest: parks, neighbourhood exploration and exterior architecture, joined as preferred uses of most sightseeing time. Keep its union as one source-linked interest rather than inventing separate category requirements. Few paid visits and lower cost describe admission/spending preferences, not additional thematic venue interests. Solo travel is trip context. This inventory is not a venue relevance judgment or corpus measurement.

interests.source_text: I am travelling alone on a limited budget. I would prefer to spend most of my sightseeing time in parks, exploring neighbourhoods and viewing architecture from outside, with a small number of paid visits. I am happy to prioritise lower-cost experiences.
